text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the spring Tenno Sho is here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo! ♪ Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio! Did you come to cheer me on?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Hishiama and I finished up all our tasks, so we dashed over here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Everyone's so excited to see you race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just take a look!

text_block_list.name: News Site
text_block_list.text: "The spring Tenno Sho—the Ultimate Face-off?!" "Who Will Win? Brian or Mayano?"

text_block_list.name: News Site
text_block_list.text: "Hanshin Daishoten's Fierce Battle Rages toward The Shield!" "Who Will Shine Brightest? Superstar Brian or Rising Star Mayano?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Are you excited? Nervous?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: There's no way something like that would scare me! Of course I'm excited!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Now that's Maya for you! I totally underestimated you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I'll accept some pudding as an apology! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heehee. Now then, Trainer… I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I won't!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get a perfect victory over Brian this time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You'd better look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After I send Mayano Top Gun off…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, Hishiama? Mayano's already left.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Did you guys see the news?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You mean the headlines about Brian? I showed them to Mayano…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: No, I mean the video that was released just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Anyway… Take a look at this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She passes me her smart phone open on a video from a news site.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Is it true, Brian? After this year's spring Tenno Sho, you're—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll be training for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: B-but… the Arima is in winter. Isn't it too early to make such a decisi—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I have some things I need to make sure of, and I need the time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I must know how far I, Narita Brian, can run!
